entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I hope you can help me. I need to return an item, and I'm just so disappointed about it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's a cycling jersey I bought a while back. I finally got a chance to try it on for a ride, and it's the wrong size. It's just... far too tight.
Okay, I see. So it's a sizing issue, not a defect with the jersey itself. Can you provide me with the order number so I can pull up the details?
Yes, it's VF886-0921. I've been a VeloFit customer for years and I always get the same size. I just feel so silly for not checking sooner. I really needed this money back if it didn't fit.
I understand completely. Let me just check that for you... one moment. Okay, I see the order was delivered about 70 days ago.
Oh no, has it been that long? I've had a lot going on. I was worried it would be too late.

Not at all. For a standard item like a jersey, you're well within our 90-day return policy. I can absolutely process this return for you. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to exchange it for a different size?
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you. I think I would like to do an exchange for one size up, if that's possible.

Of course. That's a great choice. I've just initiated the exchange process. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file right now. Just pack up the original jersey, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we see it's in transit, we'll ship out the new size to you.
That's wonderful. You've been a huge help, Sarah. I was so worried. Thank you.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
